settings.density_help: How much air each post gets in the feed.
settings.density_card: Roomy — full spacing and soft corners
settings.default_sort_help: What the front page opens on before anyone picks a sort.
settings.show_about_help: The panel on the right with the forum's description, its counts and a button to start a discussion. Turn it off and the feed takes the space back.
settings.hashtag_count_help: How many of the most-used hashtags the rail shows. Only appears when the Hashtags extension is enabled.
settings.thread_depth_help: How far a reply can move right before it stops. Deeper replies still sit under their parent, they just stop indenting — which keeps a long back-and-forth from walking off the side of the column.
settings.allow_self_votes_label: Let people vote on their own posts
settings.allow_self_votes_help: On by default, matching fof/gamification. Turn it off if you treat a self-upvote as score inflation.
